bio: Sophia graduated from Case Western Reserve University with bachelor’s degree in Medical Anthropology and Environmental Studies. During her time at CWRU, she held numerous roles in higher education programming organizations, both in and outside of Residential Life. She enjoys the logistical side of planning events, facilitating meaningful connections among students, and developing programs that promote personal growth and community engagement. Most recently, Sophia served as a teacher for an elementary classroom at the YMCA of Greater Toledo, where she developed and implemented educational programming that fostered social-emotional learning for students — though much of the time, she was simply trying to contain the chaos! Sophia is originally from Ohio and recently moved to Boston with her cat, Pippa. In her free time, Sophia can be found exploring the city, crafting, and watching soccer (with Pippa, of course). She also loves playing soccer, hiking, and horseback riding. As Residential Programs Coordinator, Sophia provides administrative and event support for a variety of Residential Life programs and manages the Cambridge Queen’s Head event space.
